notMeasuredHere: 1. This record does not prove R-9's live half (>=50 non-canary invocations from >=3 owners). The window held 9 invocations, so the probe reported insufficient-calls and gradable=false. 2. Build 5475dc1b4b predates the canary fix in 1094cfde37 (abortCooperative in code-intel-canary.ts; worker blob a13069bf18, staging blob 2b5924b4ae). The 15 earlier runs failed 5-12 cases because the forced 1 ms timeout or parent abort fired while the handler ran to completion, so the dispatcher correctly recorded measured (dispatch-stack.ts invokeStep; e.g. tool_invocations 45279818, 2544 ms, status ok). In this run the forced calls ended before the handler returned, so the unfixed canary passed. The fix that makes the forced exit deterministic is unit-proven (code-intel-canary.test.ts, test run 22415538, 20/20) and is not yet observed live on the worker.
